paragraphs: Winmark – the Resale Company® (Winmark Corporation, Winmark or the Company), is a nationally recognized franchisor focused on sustainability and small business formation. We champion and guide entrepreneurs interested in operating one of our award winning resale franchises: Plato's Closet®, Once Upon A Child®, Play It Again Sports®, Style Encore® and Music Go Round®. At December 27, 2025, there were 1,378 franchises in operation in the United States and Canada and over 2,800 available territories. Our mission is to provide Resale for Everyone®.

Each of our resale brands emphasizes consumer value by offering high-quality used merchandise at substantial savings from the price of new merchandise and by purchasing customers' used goods that have been outgrown or are no longer used. Our concepts also offer a limited amount of new merchandise to customers. For over 35 years, we have offered a sustainable solution for consumers to recycle their gently used clothing, toys, sporting goods and musical instruments. We estimate that, since 2010, stores in our resale brands have extended the lives of over 2.1 billion items. We continue to enhance our franchise model and provide our franchisees with the technology, tools and training to profitably expand their operations and evolve towards being a multi-channel retailer.

Our significant assets are located within the United States, and we generate the majority of revenues from United States operations. Revenues from Canadian franchisees in 2025, 2024 and 2023 were approximately $7.8 million, $7.3 million and $6.8 million, respectively. For additional financial information, please see Item 8 — Financial Statements and Supplementary Data. We were incorporated in Minnesota in 1988.

We began franchising the Plato's Closet brand in 1999. Plato's Closet franchisees buy and sell gently used clothing and accessories geared toward the teenage and young adult market. Customers have the opportunity to sell their used items to Plato's Closet stores and to purchase quality used clothing and accessories at prices lower than new merchandise.

We began franchising the Once Upon A Child brand in 1993. Once Upon A Child franchisees buy and sell gently used and, to a lesser extent, new children's clothing, toys, furniture, equipment and accessories. This brand primarily targets parents of children ages infant to 12 years. These customers have the opportunity to sell their used children's items to a Once Upon A Child store when outgrown and to purchase quality used children's clothing, toys, furniture and equipment at prices lower than new merchandise.

We began franchising the Play It Again Sports brand in 1988. Play It Again Sports franchisees buy, sell and trade gently used and new sporting goods, equipment and accessories for a variety of athletic activities including team sports (baseball/softball, hockey, football, lacrosse, soccer), fitness, ski/snowboard and golf among others. The stores offer a flexible mix of merchandise that is adjusted to adapt to seasonal and regional differences.

We began franchising the Style Encore brand in 2013. Style Encore franchisees buy and sell gently used women's (and to a lesser extent, men's) apparel, shoes and accessories. Customers have the opportunity to sell their used items to Style Encore stores and to purchase quality used clothing, shoes and accessories at prices lower than new merchandise.

We began franchising the Music Go Round brand in 1994. Music Go Round franchisees buy, sell and trade gently used and, to a lesser extent, new musical instruments, speakers, amplifiers, music-related electronics and related accessories.

We have developed an e-commerce platform that allows franchisees of our Music Go Round, Play It Again Sports and Style Encore brands to market and sell in-store product inventory online. Consumers that visit musicgoround.com, playitagainsports.com or style-encore.com can find all product listed by participating stores in one convenient location. Product listings are available for in-store pickup or for shipment. Our e-commerce platform assists our franchisees in marketing, increasing brand awareness, and driving consumers to local stores, which provides further opportunities for our stores to purchase product from consumers. Additionally, our franchisees use other vehicles to drive non-store sales including social media platforms (Facebook and Instagram) as well as third-party e-commerce platforms (Shopify) and marketplaces (eBay and Reverb).

Each of our franchise agreements is 10 years long. At the end of the term of each franchise agreement, each franchisee may, if certain conditions are met, "renew" the franchise relationship by signing a new 10-year franchise agreement. As of December 27, 2025 each of our five brands have the following number of franchise agreements that will expire over the next three years:
​ ​ ​ 2026 ​ ​ ​ 2027 ​ ​ ​ 2028 Plato's Closet Once Upon A Child Play It Again Sports Music Go Round

We believe that renewing a significant number of these franchise relationships is important to our continued success. If a significant number of franchise relationships are not renewed, our financial performance would be materially and adversely impacted.

Our ability to generate increased revenue and achieve higher levels of profitability depends in part on increasing the number of franchises open. Unfavorable macro-economic conditions may affect the ability of potential franchisees to obtain external financing and/or impact their net worth, both of which could lead to a lower level of openings than we have historically experienced. There can be no assurance that we will sustain our current level of franchise openings.
We may sell franchises for a territory, but the franchisee may not open.

We believe that a substantial majority of franchises awarded but not opened will open within the time period permitted by the applicable franchise agreement or we will be able to resell the territories for most of the terminated or expired franchises. However, there can be no assurance that substantially all of the currently sold but unopened franchises will open and commence paying royalties to us.

paragraphs: The following is management's discussion and analysis of certain significant factors which have affected our financial position and operating results during the periods included in the accompanying consolidated financial statements and should be read in conjunction with those consolidated financial statements. This section of this 10-K generally discusses 2025 and 2024 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2025 and 2024. Discussions of 2023 items and year-to-date comparisons between 2024 and 2023 that are not included in this Form 10-K, can be found in ‘Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations' in Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 28, 2024.

Winmark – the Resale Company is focused on sustainability and small business formation. As of December 27, 2025, we had 1,378 franchises operating under the Plato's Closet, Once Upon A Child, Play It Again Sports, Style Encore and Music Go Round brands. Our business is not capital intensive and is designed to generate consistent, recurring revenue and strong operating margins.
The financial criteria that management closely tracks to evaluate current business operations and future prospects include royalties and selling, general and administrative expenses.
Our most significant source of franchising revenue is royalties received from our franchisees. During 2025, our royalties increased $4.2 million or 5.8% compared to 2024.

Management continually monitors the level and timing of selling, general and administrative expenses. The major components of selling, general and administrative expenses include compensation and benefits, marketing & advertising, professional services, and occupancy. During 2025, selling, general and administrative expense increased $3.4 million, or 13.7%, compared to the same period last year.

Management also monitors several nonfinancial factors in evaluating the current business operations and future prospects including franchise openings and closings and franchise renewals. The following is a summary of our net store growth and renewal activity for the fiscal year ended December 27, 2025:

(1) All stores are owned and operated by franchisees. Winmark does not own or operate any corporate stores.

Renewal activity is a key focus area for management. Our franchisees sign 10-year agreements with us. The renewal of existing franchise agreements as they approach their expiration is an indicator that management monitors to determine the health of our business and the preservation of future royalties. In 2025, we renewed 98% of franchise agreements up for renewal. This percentage of renewal has ranged between 98% and 99% during the last three years.

Our ability to grow our operating income is dependent on our ability to: (i) effectively support our franchisees so that they produce higher revenues, (ii) open new franchises, and (iii) control our selling, general and administrative expenses. A detailed description of the risks to our business along with other risk factors can be found in Item 1A "Risk Factors".

In May 2021, we made the decision to no longer solicit new leasing customers and will pursue an orderly run-off of our leasing portfolio. Leasing income net of leasing expense for the fiscal year of 2025 was $2.6 million compared to $1.8 million in 2024. $2.2 million of the $2.5 million of leasing income for the fiscal year of 2025 was related to the settlement of outstanding customer litigation. As of December 27, 2025, the run-off of the portfolio was completed as we no longer had any leasing customers or leased assets. See Note 3 – "Leasing Operations" for information regarding the lease portfolio.

paragraphs: Winmark – the Resale Company® (Winmark Corporation, Winmark or the Company), 是一家 nationally recognized franchisor，專注於永續發展與小型企業成立。我們倡導並指導對經營我們獲獎的買賣二手商品特許經銷店有興趣的創業者：Plato's Closet®, Once Upon A Child®, Play It Again Sports®, Style Encore® 和 Music Go Round®。截至 2025 年 12 月 27 日，美國與加拿大共有 1,378 家特許經銷店在運作，且有超過 2,800 個可使用的地區。我們的使命是提供 Resale for Everyone®。
我們的重要資產位於美國，我們產生的收入主要來自美國運作。2025 年、2024 年與 2023 年加拿大特許經銷商的收入分別約為 7.8 百萬美元、7.3 百萬美元與 6.8 百萬美元。如需更多財務資訊，請參閱第 8 項 — 財務報表與補充資料。我們於 1988 年在明尼蘇達州註冊成立。
我們於 1999 年開始特許經銷 Plato's Closet 品牌。Plato's Closet 特許經銷商買賣輕度使用的服裝與配件，主要針對青少年與年輕成人市場。消費者有機會將他們的二手商品賣給 Plato's Closet 經銷店，並以低於全新商品的價格購買高品質的二手服裝與配件。

我們於 1993 年開始特許經銷 Once Upon A Child 品牌。Once Upon A Child 特許經銷商買賣輕度使用的兒童服裝、玩具、傢俱、設備與配件，並在較小程度上買賣新商品。此品牌主要針對嬰兒至 12 歲兒童的家長。這些消費者有機會在他們的兒童商品被長大時，將這些二手商品賣給 Once Upon A Child 經銷店，並以低於全新商品的價格購買高品質的二手兒童服裝、玩具、傢俱與設備。
我們於 1988 年開始特許經銷 Play It Again Sports 品牌。Play It Again Sports 特許經銷商買賣輕度使用與新進的運動用品、設備與配件，適用於多種運動活動，包括團隊運動（棒球/軟式棒球、冰 Hockey、足球、長曲棍球、足球）、健身、滑雪/單板滑雪與高爾夫球等。這些商店提供靈活的商品組合，根據季節與地區差異進行調整。
我們於 2013 年開始特許經銷 Style Encore 品牌。Style Encore 特許經銷商買賣輕度使用的女性（並在較小程度上，男性）服裝、鞋子與配件。消費者有機會將他們的二手商品賣給 Style Encore 經銷店，並以低於全新商品的價格購買高品質的二手服裝、鞋子與配件。
我們於 1994 年開始特許經銷 Music Go Round 品牌。Music Go Round 特許經銷商買賣輕度使用與，在較小程度上，新的音樂器材、喇叭、擴音器、與相關電子產品及配件。

543.4 Play It Again Sports 328.2 331.9 350.0 Style Encore 59.2 59.1 61.7 Music Go Round 49.2

我們已開發電商平台，使 Music Go Round、Play It Again Sports 與 Style Encore 品牌之特許經營者能線上行銷與販售實體門市之存貨。造訪 musicgoround.com、playitagainsports.com 或 style-encore.com 的消費者可於一處方便地找到所有參與門市所列的商品。商品可於門市提領或運送。我們的電商平台協助特許經營者進行行銷、提升品牌知名度，並吸引消費者前往當地門市，為門市提供進一步從消費者處購買新商品的機會。此外，我們的特許經營者亦透過其他方式推動非門市銷售，包括社交媒體平台（Facebook 與 Instagram）以及第三方電商平台（Shopify）與市集（eBay 與 Reverb）。

paragraphs: 以下為管理階層對某些重大因素之討論與分析，這些因素已影響我們在附屬合併財務報表所包含期間之財務狀況與營運結果，應與這些合併財務報表一併閱讀。本 10-K 文件之此部分一般討論 2025 年與 2024 年項目，以及 2025 年與 2024 年之間的年對年比較。有關 2023 年項目以及 2024 年與 2023 年之間的年對年比較之討論，若未包含於本 Form 10-K 文件中，可於我們 2024 年 12 月 28 日財務年度之年度報告（Form 10-K）第二部分，第 7 項「財務狀況與營運結果之管理階層討論與分析」中找到。

Winmark – the Resale Company 關注永續性與小企業成立。截至 2025 年 12 月 27 日，我們有 1,378 家特許經營商在 Plato's Closet、Once Upon A Child、Play It Again Sports、Style Encore 與 Music Go Round 品牌下運作。我們的業務不具資本密集性，設計為產生穩定、持續的營業收入與強勁的營運毛利。
管理階層密切追蹤用以評估現有業務運作與未來展望之財務指標，包括特許經營權收入與銷售、一般及行政費用。
我們最主要的特許經營權收入來源為來自特許經營商之特許經營權費用。在 2025 年，我們的特許經營權費用較 2024 年增加 4.2 百萬美元，或成長 5.8%。
管理階層持續監測銷售、一般及行政費用之金額與時點。銷售、一般及行政費用的主要零組件包括薪資與福利、行銷與廣告、專業服務及佔用空間。在 2025 年，銷售、一般及行政費用較去年同期增加 3.4 百萬美元，或成長 13.7%。
管理階層在評估現有業務運作與未來展望時，也監測若干非財務因素，包括特許經營商開店與關店數量以及特許經營權續約情形。以下為我們在 2025 年 12 月 27 日財務年度之淨門市成長與續約活動總結：

Plato's Closet (7) Once Upon A Child (6) Play It Again Sports (8) Style Encore (4) Music Go Round
(1) 所有門市均由經銷商擁有並營運。Winmark 並未擁有或營運任何公司門市。
續約活動是管理層的重要關注重點。我們的經銷商與我們簽訂 10 年期的契約。現有經銷契約在接近到期時的續約情況，是管理層監測以評估我們業務健康度及未來版稅收入保留情況的指標。2025 年，我們續約了將到期經銷契約的 98%。此續約比例在過去三年間介於 98% 到 99% 之間。
我們擴張營運收入的能力，取決於我們能否：(i) 有效支援經銷商，使其產生更高的營收，(ii) 開設新的經銷商，以及 (iii) 控制我們的營銷、一般及行政費用。有關我們業務的風險詳情及其他風險因素，請參閱第 1A 項 "風險因素"。

2021 年 5 月，我們決定不再招募新的租賃客戶，並將採取有序方式處理我們的租賃資產組合。2025 年會計年度的租賃收入淨額為 2.6 百萬美元，較 2024 年的 1.8 百萬美元增加。2025 年會計年度的租賃收入 2.5 百萬美元中，有 2.2 百萬美元與解決現有客戶訴訟有關。截至 2025 年 12 月 27 日，租賃資產組合的處理已完成，因為我們已無任何租賃客戶或租賃資產。有關租賃業務的資訊，請參閱附註 3 – "租賃業務"。

本公司每一份特許經營契約的期限為 10 年。在每一份特許經營契約的期限屆滿時，若符合特定條件，特許經營者可透過簽訂新的 10 年期特許經營契約，重新建立特許經營關係。截至 2025 年 12 月 27 日，本公司五個品牌在未來三年內將到期的特許經營契約數量如下：
​ ​ ​ 2026 ​ ​ ​ 2027 ​ ​ ​ 2028 Plato's Closet Once Upon A Child Play It Again Sports Music Go Round
我們認為，重新建立大量特許經營關係對本公司持續成功至關重要。若大量特許經營關係未能重新建立，將會對本公司財務表現造成重大且不利的影響。
本公司產生更高收入及達成更高利潤水準的能力，部分取決於增加特許經營店數。不利的總體經濟條件可能影響潛在特許經營者取得外部融資的能力及/或影響其淨 worth，這兩種情況都可能導致開店數量低於我們歷來的經驗。本公司無法保證將維持目前的特許經營開店速度。
本公司可能出售某個地區的特許經營權，但特許經營者未必會開店。
我們認為，大部分已授予但尚未開店的特許經營權，將在適用特許經營契約允許的時間內開店，或我們將能重新出售大部分已終止或到期的特許經營權。然而，本公司無法保證目前已出售但尚未開店的特許經營權將全部開店並開始向本公司支付特許經營費。
